facts.fact: Google states that Google Analytics is the go-to platform for millions of website and app owners (vendor claim, no exact count given).
facts.quote: Google Analytics is the go-to platform for millions of website and app owners seeking to gain a deeper understanding of their website and app performance.

facts.fact: Google provides free courses on Skillshop to help users get started with Google Analytics.
facts.quote: Google provides free courses to help you get started with Google Analytics.

facts.fact: Google's Learn with GMP program offers live Google Analytics 360 courses taught by subject matter experts in US, Canada, and Latin America time zones.
facts.quote: Learn more about Google Analytics 360 by attending a live course with subject matter experts offered in US, Canada, and Latin America time zones.

facts.fact: According to the page, certified GMP Partners can access exclusive partner-only Google Analytics learning resources through the Enterprise Marketing Portal.
facts.quote: Are you a certified GMP Partner? Visit the EMP for exclusive partner-only resources to deepen your Google Analytics knowledge.
